_note: Sample snapshot pulled 2026-10-20 for sign-off. Activity windows from Sales Tracker 2026 Inputs tab; pipeline from Pipeline Review October sections; slots from Messi's #sales-reports post (Mon 10/19 for the Monday card, Tue 10/20 for the Wednesday preview). Activity arrays are [booked calls, live calls, offers, closes, revenue generated, cash collected].

pipeline._note: Counts from each closer's October section. hc/sv/working are open leads; closed/signed are October rows already won; nonstandard = open rows whose Status is blank or not one of the three categories.

_calendar_close_note: Latest end of each closer's Calendly discovery hours on weekdays, converted to ET (from the round-robin Discovery event's host schedules; Julien from his 'Sales Calls' schedule).
_closer_notes_note: Manual context from Sheila. While a closer is away, the late-slot Focus item is replaced by a reminder to open evening slots when they are back.
_messi_note: Messi's 8am #sales-reports post: Calendly discovery start times over the next 7 days, keyed by post date. No post on Oct 12.
_noshow_confirm_note: EOD no-shows checked in Close: a text or email to the lead the day before or the day of the call, before it started. 'setter' = a setter (Quinn, Jose, Jabali) sent at least one; 'closer' = only the closer did.
_daily_note: daily_eod: EOD Tracker [scheduled, showed, no-show, cancelled, rescheduled] per report date. daily_st: Sales Tracker Inputs [sched, live]. Booked/showed = EOD, with any day missing from the EOD filled from the Sales Tracker; the merged total is the source of truth.
